core.name: Accelerant
core.text:
Morale (max 100) fills by 2.9 per second, plus 0.26 per Energy any squad member spends. At 80, his next switch-in is an instant Quick Assist, and his 5th Basic hit enters Morale Burst: a stronger light punch, jab combo and Finishing Move that drain Morale on hit, each 10 spent giving +{0}% Impact (max {1}%, 6s). No passive Morale gain during Burst; running out mid-combo auto-fires a stronger Finishing Move.
In Burst, light punch and jab hits lower Ice and Fire RES by 15% for 30s, and the Finishing Move applies Collapse: +3s Stun (once per Stun). Burst ends on the Finishing Move, switching out, or running out of Morale; unused Morale is kept.

ability.name: Fighting Spirit
ability.text: In Morale Burst, his 5th Basic hit gives the squad Elation (max 20, 30s): +1.25% Ice and Fire DMG each, +0.25% more per 10 Impact above 170 (max 75% total). Any squad Chain Attack refreshes it.

mindscapes: Collapse adds 5s of Stun and lowers Ice and Fire RES by 10% more. The out-of-Morale Finishing Move deals +30% DMG.
Collapse raises the enemy's Stun DMG Multiplier by 25%. Elation is 120% as strong.
While he's off-field, the on-field Agent gets +10% Energy Regen. Entering Morale Burst gives off-field Agents 4 Energy (once per 18s).

Double Morale gain. His heavy hits trigger Blazing Impact for 250% ATK as Fire DMG (once per 8s per enemy), +5% per Impact above 170 (max +500%). The out-of-Morale Finishing Move triggers it again, ignoring the cooldown.
